capacity.says: Design: 300,000–400,000 t of concentrate a year in, about 3,500–4,000 t of molybdenum concentrate out.

grade.says: The molybdenum concentrate will grade 48–52 % Mo with under 2 % Cu.

reagents.says: Sodium hydrosulfide, sodium hypochlorite, caustic soda, frother, carbon dioxide, defoaming agents and emulsified diesel.

molybdenum plant uses a suite of consumable products

packing.says: The concentrate is thickened, filtered and dried, then packed into bulk bags for transport.
